title: Page 4
transc:
Jaques  Wash. Jan 31. 1864
Knoxville Tenn  4 PM
for Foster Orders have
been issued to relieve
you State what place
you wish to go
to & I will
teleg the order applause
Henrietta Jan 30 1st


Matthews  Wash. D. C. Jan. 31. 1864.
Cumberland Md.
for Kelly Genl Wheaton's Brigade &
the several detached Regts sent to
Harpers ferry are still there subject
to your orders Period By moving
your troops to the point threatened
you will be abandantly able to 
cope with Early's forces unless they
have been greatly increased Keep me
advised of the condition of things
Applause
